title:
Responsive container that adjusts the width of its content based on the available space on screen.
The width of the content will be the largest of:
- The minimum width of the content (minContentWidth)
- The width of the container minus the padding (2 * maxContainerPadding)
name: GenAiUiResponsiveContainer
